categories.definition: A visible entry action is disabled by backend configuration, and its failure does not provide a clear recovery action.
categories.evidence_grade: Current-source frontend + real backend user-entry attempt

categories.definition: An older deployed image produces behavior that differs from current source; do not attribute it to current source without a matching build.
categories.evidence_grade: Deployed artifact, approximately nine hours old

categories.definition: A local proxy configuration causes a request failure that is not produced by the product source path.
categories.evidence_grade: Invalid run; excluded from product findings

categories.definition: A real AgentRun creates one candidate plan without tool errors, duplicate reads, or repair calls.
categories.evidence_grade: Real model + Agent + tools in isolated harness

categories.definition: A real AgentRun pauses with the expected pending approval and does not resume or apply it.
categories.evidence_grade: Real model + Agent + HITL proposal in isolated harness

categories.definition: A test assertion expected old filters, planner layout, visible internal tool traces, or approval copy; fixtures and interactions were updated to match current product behavior.
categories.evidence_grade: Resolved harness mismatch; full smoke suite passed 17/17 after selector and fixture corrections

categories.definition: Source inspection indicates a contrast, focus, status announcement, heading, or keyboard-navigation gap.
categories.evidence_grade: Source audit only; no screen-reader claim

categories.definition: A pending approval identifies a conflict only by count or requires the user to calculate the overlap from separate intervals.
categories.status: Resolved for the scoped approval review UI; live browser AgentRun approval/apply remains unverified.
categories.evidence_grade: Backend event/action-proposal tests, current-source mocked Playwright, independent simulator, blind screenshot judge, adversarial critic, and accessibility review

categories.definition: An approval or edited proposal cannot be fully reviewed against current backend state, a fresh conflict is found, or the target event version changed after proposal creation.
categories.status: Resolved: incomplete/conflicting review stays pending; a stale target is refreshed and visibly requires a new decision before execution.
categories.evidence_grade: Backend service tests plus current-source mocked Playwright/component coverage

categories.category: Partial event update has incomplete preview
categories.definition: A legacy event update omits a field or supplies null for a field that the tool treats as unchanged, but the review preview fails instead of resolving the current value.
categories.status: Resolved: null start/end fields use the existing event values and produce a complete preview.
categories.evidence_grade: Backend regression test for title-only update preview with null time fields

categories.category: Approval target changed after proposal creation
categories.definition: A high-risk event update is approved using an expected object version that no longer matches the current event.
categories.status: Resolved for mutate_events approvals: refreshes the pending payload and display, then requires another explicit decision; same idempotency-key replay stays pending.
categories.evidence_grade: Backend service regression test plus current-source approval-card/component coverage
categories.journey: Approve or edit a pending event update

categories.category: Approval editor sends display-only fields to a strict tool
categories.definition: A review form serializes UI presentation fields or an invalid interval into a resumed event mutation.
categories.status: Resolved: UI-only fields are stripped and invalid time ranges are blocked; strict tool schema is exercised through the resumed operation test.
categories.evidence_grade: Backend resumed-agent test and frontend component tests

categories.category: Partial mutation edit loses current time context
categories.definition: A mutation with null time fields opens an editor with blank values, making a title-only edit confusing or risking an unintended time rewrite.
categories.status: Resolved: current times are shown for context; unchanged times remain null in the submitted partial update, while changing one endpoint preserves the other.
categories.evidence_grade: Frontend component regressions plus independent read-only critic recheck

categories.definition: Asynchronous reminder target loading misses initial focus, or a soft keyboard closing leaves fixed navigation inaccessible while an input remains focused.
categories.status: Resolved in mocked interaction coverage: focus is retried when selector data becomes ready and viewport-based keyboard state restores navigation.
categories.evidence_grade: Component tests, current-source Playwright E2E, independent accessibility source review

required_failure_types.evidence: Checkpoint C candidate offers registration but no no-account demo entry under current backend options; the blind judge rated candidate goal fit 1/5. The capability gap is unresolved.

Checkpoint A current-source browser: guest CTA was visible while backend guest access was disabled; the API returned '游客体验当前未开放。'. Registration tab was present, so this was a misleading CTA rather than a total dead-end.
Checkpoint A simulator stopped at the disabled-guest message instead of choosing the already-visible registration tab. Candidate removes the disabled CTA; the no-account goal still cannot complete.
Checkpoint A critic source review found the Preview uses generic no-slot text instead of a specific, actionable reason; not fixed in the account-entry iteration.

Initially count-only; iteration 1 added the conflicting event and occupied interval, then iteration 2 added backend-authored exact overlap. Independent blind judge preferred the overlap candidate (X, confidence 0.99); 320px disclosure and scroll reachability are covered by mocked Playwright. Real browser AgentRun approval/apply and screen-reader behavior remain unverified.

required_failure_types.journey: Approve or edit a pending event update
required_failure_types.evidence: Iteration 3 critic found an event version could change after proposal creation. The service now refreshes the pending payload, records the review attempt idempotently, and requires a new explicit confirmation; the latest full suite verifies this behavior.

required_failure_types.journey: Review a partial legacy event update
required_failure_types.evidence: Iteration 3 critic found null start/end fields could make a title-only legacy update preview incomplete. The preview now preserves current times; backend regression coverage verifies the case.
Earlier timezone iteration blocks ambiguous repeated times, but users cannot select which occurrence they intend; unit/component evidence, no live browser journey.

Checkpoint B initially found missing tab arrow navigation, retry focus return, and undersized retry target; all scoped findings passed the independent retest after iteration 2/3. Other product-wide screen-reader and keyboard findings remain source-only.
